paper_title: Short-range spin-dependent interactions of electrons: a probe for exotic pseudo-Goldstone bosons
notes: Paper reports two independent measurements: (1) Dipole-dipole (Vdd) constraints on (g_e_p)^2/(hbar*c) for m_b ≤ 500 µeV, reaching 5.5×10^-17 for m_b < 30 µeV (AxionElectron type, not extracted here). (2) Monopole-dipole (Vmd) CP-violating constraints on |(g_e_p * g_N_s)|/(hbar*c) for 1.5 µeV < m_b < 400 µeV at the 10^-28 level, improving previous bounds by up to 1000×. The monopole-dipole result is the primary new constraint highlighted in the abstract. The coupling convention represents the product of electron pseudoscalar coupling g_e_p and nucleon scalar coupling g_N_s, normalized by hbar*c. The mass range 1.5–400 µeV is encoded as a horizontal line at 10^-28. Confidence is 0.75 because the paper clearly identifies the monopole-dipole coupling type and mass range, but the exact numerical value (10^-28) is inferred from Fig. 5 caption and text rather than an explicit table entry for all mass points. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
